keep.text: Aaj subah aap logon ne kya khaya?
Poha?
Upma?
Aloo paratha?
Ya phir
bread butter?
Healthy samajh ke khaya hoga aap logon ne ye saari cheezein.
Par ye sab ki sab cheezein naked carb hain.
Naked carb matlab ki carb jinhone kapde nahi pehne hain.
Ab wo kapda kis cheez ka hota hai?
Ek hota hai fiber ka layer, aur ek hota hai protein ka layer.
Ab jab ye dono saath mein carb ke rehte hain, tab jaake poori
ek proper meal banti hai.
Ab samjho hota kya hai. Jab aap log naked carb khaate ho toh
poha khaya, wo break hua, glucose bana.
Theek, glucose seedha aapki bloodstream mein gaya,
spike aaya blood sugar ka,
aur bahut tezi se spike aaya.
Ab aapke pancreas ne dekha ki itna saara glucose aa gaya hai body mein,
turant insulin release kar do.
Turant insulin release hona shuru ho gaya, bahut zyada insulin aa gaya, kyunki spike bahut tez hua tha toh insulin bhi bahut zyada aggressive rahega.
Ab itne zyada insulin ne
glucose ko jaldi se cell mein dhakel diya.
Ab sugar crash ho gayi.
Toh brain ki energy ekdam khatam.
Result: aap logon ko neend, lethargic type ka
aap logon ko lagne laga,
focus ekdam khatam ho gaya, focus ekdam chala gaya.
Do se teen baje dopahar mein hi aankh band hone lagi aap logon ki.
Ab wahi poha agar aapne dress up karke khaya hota
toh kaisa hota?
Pehle thoda salad khaya hota,
kheera, tamatar, aur ye saari cheezein jo fiber hoti hain achhi, wo khaate,
kyunki fiber ek resistant
starch hai,
slowly digest hota hai,
aur ye aapke gut mein ek layer bana deta hai.
Phir poha ke saath aap moong daal ke sprouts kha liye hote, thode chane kha liye hote, ubla hua anda kha liye hote,
toh ye protein de deta hai aap logon ko.
Ab ye naked carb ko achhe tareeke se dress up
karke ek meal bani.
Ab glucose
slowly release hoga, aur gently
aapki body mein aayega.
Gently aapka insulin spike karega, gently aapka insulin normal bhi aayega, crash nahi karega.
Toh aapko baar baar jo bhookh lag rahi hai na, khana khane ke baad bhi,
toh wo nahi lagegi.
Toh poha galat nahi hai.
Carb galat nahi hai, naked carb galat hai. Sirf aur sirf carb khaoge toh phir mote hi hoge na.
Aur ye sab sirf ek meal ki baat nahi hai.
Aapke poore din mein breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks,
sab ka sab glucose spike karta hai.
Sabka glucose management karna padega, chahe kuch bhi ho jaaye.
Kaun sa carb kahan khana hai,
kitna protein lena hai, kaise lena hai, aur ye saari cheezein personalized hain.
Maine jab apna vajan ghataya
toh mujhe ye saari cheezein pata chali
ki meri body mein kya kya cheezon ki kami hai,
kaise mera insulin spike hota tha. Main glucose meter laga karke rakhta tha,
dekhta tha ki kaun sa khana kitna glucose spike kar raha hai.
Toh ye saari cheezein dheere dheere dheere samjha,
aur meal ka architecture ekdam banaya.
Aur jab ye bana
toh itna khoobsurat nikla, meri body aaj
mujhe itne achhe se thank you bol rahi hai, main aapko kya bataun.
Itna halka feel hota hai mujhe,
itna achha feel hota hai mujhe ki
mujhe aisa lagta hai alag se phir se confidence aa gaya hai.
Jab aapki thaali science basis par banti hai na,
toh body aisa thank you bolti hai ki aap soch nahi sakte ho.
Toh mera kaam tha science pahunchana, decision aapka hai. You are watching FitFinfluencer. Milte hain next video mein!
